name: South Fork Payette
gaugeName: South Fork Payette River at Lowman
blurb: Canyon water out of Lowman — hot springs on the bank, Swirly Canyon in the middle, Garden Valley at the bottom.

sections.notes: The Kirkham/Lowman to Deadwood area includes Class III+ rapids in BLM guide SF02. Staircase is much farther downstream, between Garden Valley and Banks; it is not above Lowman.
sections.accessReview: Kirkham and Lowman are different launch locations. The former six-mile listing combined them; a specific legal landing and matching distance must be established before enabling this trip.

sections.notes: BLM guide SF04 covers 8.6 miles from Danskin to Alder Creek; SF05 adds 4.4 miles from Alder Creek to Confluence. Stop at the Garden Valley/Middle Fork confluence access. Continuing to Banks enters the more difficult Staircase run.

distanceEvidence.sourceName: BLM Payette River guide, SF04 + SF05
distanceEvidence.streamId: South Fork Payette / Danskin to Confluence
distanceEvidence.note: Sum of contiguous BLM guide lengths: SF04 8.6 miles plus SF05 4.4 miles. This is a guide length, not a GPS trace.
